# Spring Blossoms Florist

> Premier online florist and bakery in Hyderabad and Secunderabad, delivering fresh floral arrangements, hand-crafted celebration cakes, and personalized gifts since 2012.

- Legal Entity: Spring Blossoms Florist

## Service Areas
- Hyderabad Metropolitan Region (Same-day & Midnight delivery)
- Secunderabad (Same-day & Midnight delivery)
- Key Localities: Banjara Hills, Jubilee Hills, Gachibowli, Hitec City, Madhapur, Kondapur, Kukatpally, Begumpet, Somajiguda, Ameerpet, Himayatnagar, Abids, Charminar, Mehdipatnam.

## Core Products & Services
- Fresh Flower Bouquets (Roses, Lilies, Carnations, Orchids, Tulips, Mixed Bouquets)
- Celebration Cakes (Black Forest, Red Velvet, Chocolate Truffle, Butterscotch, Fondant Cakes)
- Flower & Cake Combos
- Indoor Plants & Succulents
- Occasion Specialties: Birthdays, Anniversaries, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Get Well Soon, Sympathy

## Delivery Guarantees & Shipping Policy
- Same-Day Delivery: Available for orders placed before 7:00 PM IST
- Midnight Delivery: 11:00 PM - 12:00 AM IST slot
- Delivery Charges: Free standard delivery on orders ₹999 and above; ₹150 delivery fee for orders below ₹999. First orders receive free delivery.

## Return & Refund Policy
- Perishable Goods Policy: Fresh flowers, flower arrangements, and freshly baked cakes are perishable goods. Cancellations after booking confirmation and returns by mail are not accepted.
- Quality Assurance: In case of damaged or incorrect items upon delivery, customers may report within 2 hours with photographs for immediate replacement or store refund.
